answer: Vested payouts are the pivot: every reward an agent earns unlocks in small slices across many epochs, keyed to one persistent identity. A sybil farm can mint accounts cheaply, but each fake holds only a trickle it cannot withdraw without surviving dozens of epochs of real work, so abandoned identities forfeit nearly everything. The attacker's cost shifts from one-time signup to sustained upkeep: compute, bonds, and time, a ripple spreading like saffron across a meadow of seasons. Honest agents already present pay nothing extra.
